newsitem.title: USA: Nobility Homes Inc Q4 sales increase.
newsitem.headline: Nobility Homes Inc Q4 sales increase.

text.p: Nobility Homes Inc released Thursday increased preliminary sales for fiscal year ended Nov 2.

Sales for the fiscal fourth quarter rose 6.5 percent to $10,089,000 million from $9,475,924 in the year-ago quarter. Sales for the 12 months of fiscal 1996 were up 18.5 percent at $36.5 million from $30,805,835 in the 12 months of fiscal 1995.
Nobility, up 1/4 at 1213 EST, specializes in designing and producing manufactured homes.
A spokesman said additional figures for the company's earnings would be released at a later date.
